SAINTexpress: Pure R Implementation of SAINTexpress

Source: R/SAINTexpress-package.R
saintexpress-package.Rd

Scores bait-prey interactions in affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS) experiments with the SAINTexpress model (Teo et al. 2014). For each prey detected in the purification of a bait, SAINT compares the prey's spectral counts or intensities in the bait purifications with those in negative-control purifications and returns the probability that the interaction is genuine.

Details

The package reimplements the spectral-count (SAINTexpress-spc) and intensity (SAINTexpress-int) engines of the native C++ SAINTexpress 3.6.3 in R. Its output has the columns of the native list.txt file.

Main functions:

  • run_saint() scores a SAINT input list.

  • validate_saint_input() checks a SAINT input list before scoring.

A subset of the real AP-MS dataset TIP49 (the example shipped with SAINTexpress) and the native SAINTexpress 3.6.3 results for it are in inst/extdata/tip49; see the vignette.

References

Teo G, Liu G, Zhang J, Nesvizhskii AI, Gingras AC, Choi H (2014). SAINTexpress: Improvements and additional features in Significance Analysis of INTeractome software. Journal of Proteomics, 100, 37-43. doi:10.1016/j.jprot.2013.10.023
